name: ingest-docs
description: Admin-only. Ingest documentation into the support-docs RAG collection. Three source_kinds: 'web' (single URL OR same-domain BFS crawl up to crawl_config.max_depth), 'sitemap' (fetches a sitemap.xml and ingests each URL), 'uploaded_file' (storage_object_id), 'text' (raw). Records one docs_sources row covering the whole crawl; each page becomes its own RAG document. F2: rag_document_ids tracks every RAG documentId for precise delete. F3: multi-page crawl with same-domain BFS + sitemap support.
